permissions.claim_scope: No training or calibration. Deployable arms use only received IQ and same-domain legal s3147 frozen source weights/geometry. An isolated source diagnostic uses paired Clean only to estimate phase, never to activate or score deployment. V labels only in separate post-prediction scorer. No target.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Strict frozen checkpoint load and actual no-query U_s smoke on both datasets.

checkpoint.selection_rule: The primary phase_then_dura can qualify only if Clean matches the strongest of original raw, DURA and independent gain, and the low-urban net increases by >=8/160 against each with positive 95% paired lower bound. Isolated phase and reference never qualify as method.

execution.launch_owner: Current LoRa performance chat, dual dataset objective
execution.gpu_policy: Physical {0,3,7}, >=12288 MiB free and <8 visible contexts. At most one task worker per used card. Other owners preserved.
execution.stop_rule: Stop own path on incompatible frozen checkpoint, source IQ/order, nonfinite model output, invalid no-query smoke or missing complete matrix. Independent scoring only after both matrices freeze.

notes: Observable second difference of phase links from adjacent received periods, weighted by complex coherence and angular agreement. Relative quadratic component only. Same receiver algorithm for LoRa 8×1024 and WiSig [80:160) 4×20. Correction basis has zero weighted center and zero endpoints, symmetric and angle capped at 0.8 rad. Unit-modulus multiplication preserves IQ amplitude and samples outside the verified region.

Primary only adds the observable phase correction before the same frozen s3147 DURA. Gate references and model weights identical. Phase-only receive branch and paired Clean-reference phase branch are independent diagnostics; the latter is intentionally not deployable. Exact same observable quality gate and phase-rendering cap apply in both standalone phase diagnostics.

Prediction-stage programs do not see TX labels. Source-only paired Clean waveform is used only in diagnostic reference code. The CPU label process outputs all paired differences, by-TX counts and union of correct decisions across the three existing controls. This union is a perfect-routing ceiling only for those existing decisions on this panel.
